**Feature Description**
A clear and concise description of the proposed feature or capability.

**Motivation & FYP Scope Alignment**
Explain how this aligns with the Final Year Project objectives (e.g. Iteration 2 classification, 5G NR, OTFS research extension).

**Proposed Technical Approach**
- Mathematical foundations / standards reference (e.g. 3GPP TS 36.211 / TS 38.211):
- Architecture / class design:
- Impact on memory and real-time streaming:

**Validation Plan**
How will this feature be tested and qualified (synthetic vectors, reference implementations, over-the-air capture)?
